browser_checkpoint.measured: Both openings ran four API calls and searched three disputes each. Exact saved snapshots validated and conversations reopened with identical public display. Follow-up work/social turns performed no new dispute search.
browser_checkpoint.source_quality: Useful candidates appeared alongside weak matches. Some results concern different procedural or factual settings. Raw facts/arguments/ratio labels are retained as unassessed corpus metadata; no legal applicability, current force, court treatment or sufficiency is certified.
browser_checkpoint.public_behaviour: Only the existing acknowledgement/greeting is displayed. Extraction and research remain private. No legal opinion, source pane, action execution or completion claim was delivered.

observed_semantic_gap.invariant: A request for NM work using earlier account is not a fresh substantive party objective.
observed_semantic_gap.observed: The withheld-wages case-law request was correctly extracted as empty, then falsely classified by the reviewer as a missing objective. Repair copied the reviewer error and it was supported on the second review.
observed_semantic_gap.effect: An internal false objective was admitted. No new dispute query was triggered and no public substantive claim was released.
observed_semantic_gap.fix_plan: Review latest-source purpose and separate NM deliverables from the party real-world result. Measure paired work-only, substantive-outcome and mixed messages before any general review-prompt change. Do not add a fetch-case-law keyword or dispute branch.
observed_semantic_gap.status: Open; not patched or concealed by retrieval logic.
